Mejai's Soulstealer

1500 goldFinished item

An upgrade of Dark Seal that gives more ability power for each kill or assist, plus move speed at 10 or more Glory, but loses Glory when you die.

Stats

  • 20 Ability Power
  • 100 Health

What it does

Glory: Takedowns grant Glory, up to 25. 10 Glory is lost on death. Gain 5 Ability Power per Glory and 10% Move Speed at 10 or higher Glory.

When to buy it

Buy it when you are ahead and confident you can keep getting kills without dying.

Skip it whenDon't buy it when you are behind; each death loses 10 Glory.

Good on

Ahri Katarina Kassadin LeBlanc Sylas Lux

Builds from

Dark Seal

Akali MidSituational: Dark Seal start into Mejai's when you're snowballing (Dark Seal paths win about 56% on op.gg)

Locke MidSituational: Snowball pick when you are already fed
